```{r}
library(Seurat)
library(scRepertoire)
seurat.merge <- readRDS("./data/seurat.merged.rds")

seurat.merge <- SplitObject(seurat.merge, "orig.ident")

output.list <- list(TRBV.genes = list(),
                    TRBJ.genes = list(),
                    TRAV.genes = list(),
                    TRAJ.genes = list(),
                    TRB.aa = list(),
                    TRA.aa = list(),
                    TRB.2mer = list(),
                    TRB.3mer = list(),
                    TRA.2mer = list(),
                    TRA.3mer = list(),
                    diversity = list())

for(i in seq_along(seurat.merge)) {
  if (any(grepl("CTaa", colnames(seurat.merge[[i]][[]])))) {
    if(any(!is.na(seurat.merge[[i]]$CTaa))) {
      seurat.merge[[i]]$cloneSize <-seurat.merge[[i]]$cloneType
      #Gene Level Quantifications
      output.list[[1]][[i]] <- percentGenes(seurat.merge[[i]], 
                                            chain = "TRB",
                                            gene = "Vgene", 
                                            exportTable = TRUE)
      output.list[[2]][[i]] <- percentGenes(seurat.merge[[i]], 
                                            chain = "TRB",
                                            gene = "Jgene", 
                                            exportTable = TRUE)
      
      output.list[[3]][[i]] <- percentGenes(seurat.merge[[i]], 
                                            chain = "TRA",
                                            gene = "Vgene", 
                                            exportTable = TRUE)
      output.list[[4]][[i]]<- percentGenes(seurat.merge[[i]], 
                                           chain = "TRA",
                                           gene = "Jgene", 
                                           exportTable = TRUE)
      #AA Usage by Position
      output.list[[5]][[i]]<- percentAA(seurat.merge[[i]], 
                                           chain = "TRB",
                                           exportTable = TRUE)
      output.list[[5]][[i]]$variable <- paste0(output.list[[5]][[i]]$variable, "_", output.list[[5]][[i]]$AA)
      values <- output.list[[5]][[i]]$value
      names(values) <- output.list[[5]][[i]]$variable
      output.list[[5]][[i]] <-  as.data.frame(t(values))
      
      output.list[[6]][[i]]<- percentAA(seurat.merge[[i]], 
                                           chain = "TRA",
                                           exportTable = TRUE)
      output.list[[6]][[i]]$variable <- paste0(output.list[[6]][[i]]$variable, "_", output.list[[6]][[i]]$AA)
      values <- output.list[[6]][[i]]$value
      names(values) <- output.list[[6]][[i]]$variable
      output.list[[6]][[i]] <- as.data.frame(t(values))
      
      output.list[[7]][[i]] <- as.data.frame(t(percentKmer(seurat.merge[[i]], 
                                               chain = "TRB",
                                               cloneCall = "aa",
                                               motif.length = 2,
                                               top.motifs = NULL, 
                                               exportTable = TRUE)))
      output.list[[8]][[i]] <- as.data.frame(t(percentKmer(seurat.merge[[i]], 
                                               chain = "TRB",
                                               cloneCall = "aa",
                                               motif.length = 3,
                                               top.motifs = NULL, 
                                                exportTable = TRUE)))
      
      output.list[[9]][[i]] <- as.data.frame(t(percentKmer(seurat.merge[[i]], 
                                               chain = "TRA",
                                               cloneCall = "aa",
                                               motif.length = 2,
                                               top.motifs = NULL, 
                                                exportTable = TRUE)))
      output.list[[10]][[i]] <-  as.data.frame(t(percentKmer(seurat.merge[[i]], 
                                                  chain = "TRA",
                                                  cloneCall = "aa",
                                                  motif.length = 3,
                                                  top.motifs = NULL, 
                                                  exportTable = TRUE)))
      
      output.list[[11]][[i]] <- clonalDiversity(seurat.merge[[i]], 
                                                n.boots = 1, 
                                                exportTable = TRUE)[,c(1:6)]
    } else {
    output.list[[1]][[i]] <- NULL
    output.list[[2]][[i]] <- NULL
    output.list[[3]][[i]] <- NULL
    output.list[[4]][[i]] <- NULL
    output.list[[5]][[i]] <- NULL
    output.list[[6]][[i]] <- NULL
    output.list[[7]][[i]] <- NULL
    output.list[[8]][[i]] <- NULL
    output.list[[9]][[i]] <- NULL
    output.list[[10]][[i]] <- NULL
    output.list[[11]][[i]] <- NULL
    }
  } else {
    output.list[[1]][[i]] <- NULL
    output.list[[2]][[i]] <- NULL
    output.list[[3]][[i]] <- NULL
    output.list[[4]][[i]] <- NULL
    output.list[[5]][[i]] <- NULL
    output.list[[6]][[i]] <- NULL
    output.list[[7]][[i]] <- NULL
    output.list[[8]][[i]] <- NULL
    output.list[[9]][[i]] <- NULL
    output.list[[10]][[i]] <- NULL
    output.list[[11]][[i]] <- NULL
  }
}
for(i in seq_along(output.list)) {
  names(output.list[[i]]) <- names(seurat.merge)
  output.list[[i]] <- output.list[[i]][lengths(output.list[[i]]) != 0]
}

saveRDS(output.list, "TCR_repertoire_summaries.rds")
rm(seurat.merge)
gc()
```


```{r}
assay.list <- NULL
for(i in seq_along(output.list)) {
  list_of_elements <- lapply(output.list[[i]], function(x) {
    ele <- colnames(x)
    return(ele)
  })
  dictionary <- unique(unlist(list_of_elements))
  
  element_matrix <- matrix(nrow = length(output.list[[i]]), ncol = length(dictionary), 0)
  colnames(element_matrix) <- stringr::str_sort(dictionary, numeric = TRUE)
  rownames(element_matrix) <- names(output.list[[i]])
  
  for(x in seq_along(output.list[[i]])) {
    column.positions <- match(colnames(output.list[[i]][[x]]), colnames(element_matrix))
    element_matrix[x,column.positions] <- unlist(as.vector(output.list[[i]][[x]]))
  }

  assay.list[[i]] <- element_matrix
}
names(assay.list) <- names(output.list)


rownames(assay.list[[1]])

for(i in seq_along(assay.list)) {
  assay.list[[i]] <- assay.list[[i]][rownames(assay.list[[1]]),]
}

test <- CreateSeuratObject(counts = t(assay.list[[1]]), assay = names(assay.list)[[1]])
for(i in 2:11) {
  test[[names(assay.list)[i]]] <- CreateAssayObject(counts = t(assay.list[[i]]))
}

meta.data <- as.data.frame(readxl::read_xlsx("./summaryInfo/File.Inventory.xlsx"))
meta.data <- meta.data[meta.data$Sample %in% rownames(test[[]]),]
rownames(meta.data) <- meta.data$Sample
test <- AddMetaData(test, meta.data)
test@meta.data <- test@meta.data[,25:40]

saveRDS(test, "Seurat_TCRsummary.rds")
```
